GraceDeployment.Target: Offline Debian/Astra Linux installation with systemd API/worker services, SQLite data directory, verified backups and rollback-capable updates.
GraceDeployment.Notes: Every merge candidate passes the compact project check. GRACE is added only for governed high-risk changes. Release promotion additionally follows the release gate, full offline bundle verification, backup/restore requirements and target-system acceptance. GitHub main should require pull requests, the always-present project check and linear history; conditional risk workflows are verified when applicable rather than configured as permanently required contexts.
